# harness-kit

> harness-kit is an open-source CLI and setup guide for harness engineering. In an existing repo, `npx @deepklarity/harnesskit init` adds a setup guide; a coding agent such as Claude Code then reads the code and writes a routing CLAUDE.md, a guide per flow citing file and line, inspect and log scripts per component, and tests with one check command. harness-kit then runs the same tasks with and without that harness and has a blind judge compare them.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): what it does, quick start, results, safety, FAQ
- [Setup guide](harness-kit/kit/entry.md): the procedure the agent follows after init
- [Proof procedure](harness-kit/kit/docs/proof.md): how before-and-after runs are set up and judged
- [Skills](harness-kit/kit/skills/README.md): the optional skills it can install
- [Changelog](harness-kit/CHANGELOG.md)
